title: Reply to Ranger Fern
task: Read the email from Ranger Fern and the notes you have made. Write your email to Fern using all the notes. Write about 100 words.

email.text: Hi! Thanks for volunteering for the Lantern Festival clean-up next Saturday. Would you prefer to collect rubbish or decorate the trees? Could you bring anything? We start at 9 am. Is that OK for you?

model:
Hi Fern,

Thanks for your email! I'm really excited about the clean-up because I've never done anything like this before.

I'd prefer to decorate the trees, as I love making things and I'm quite good at climbing. If you want, I can bring some paper lanterns and a big bag of fairy lights from home.

Starting at 9 am is fine for me, but I might be a few minutes late because the first forest bus only arrives at 8.55.

See you on Saturday!
Best wishes,
Mia

p: If you want, I can bring …
It was great to hear from you.

title: Your Pen Friend Is Coming!
task: Read the email from your pen friend Arlo and the notes you have made. Write your email to Arlo using all the notes. Write about 100 words.

email.text: Great news: I'm coming to visit your town next month! What should I see while I'm there? What should I pack? And could we go somewhere special together?

model:
Hi Arlo,

It's fantastic news that you're coming! I can't wait to show you my town.

You should definitely visit the old castle on the hill, because the view from the tower is amazing. The flower market on Sunday mornings is lovely too.

The weather here changes quickly, so don't forget to pack an umbrella and a warm jacket.

Why don't we take the little boat to the Whispering Islands? I've been there twice and it's the most magical place I know.

Let me know when you arrive!
Best wishes,
Noor

p: It was great to hear from you.

title: The Old Wooden Box
task: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story. Your story must begin with this sentence: “As soon as Mia opened the old wooden box, the forest went completely silent.” Write about 100 words.
firstLine: As soon as Mia opened the old wooden box, the forest went completely silent.
model:
As soon as Mia opened the old wooden box, the forest went completely silent. Inside, there was a tiny golden key and a note that said: "Give me back my song."

Suddenly, Mia realised that all the birds had stopped singing. She was scared, but she decided to follow the path to the oldest tree. There, she found a small door with a lock.

Mia turned the key and hundreds of songs flew out like butterflies. In the end, the whole forest was singing again, and from that day on the birds always sang a little louder near Mia's house.

p: It was great to hear from you.

title: My Favourite Place to Relax
task: You see this notice in the Forest Gazette: “Articles wanted! Where is your favourite place to relax? What do you do there? Why is it special to you?” Write your article in about 100 words.
model:
The Secret Willow

Have you ever wanted to hide from the world for an hour? My favourite place to relax is under an old willow tree by the river, just ten minutes from my house.

When I get there, I usually sit on its roots, listen to the water and read a good book. Sometimes I draw the ducks that swim past.

What makes it special is the quiet. Nobody can find me there, so I always feel calm and peaceful. I've been going there since I was little, and it still feels like my own secret world.

p: It was great to hear from you.

title: Advice for a Nervous Friend
task: Read the email from your friend Jade and the notes you have made. Write your email to Jade using all the notes. Write about 100 words.

email.text: I've got my first big exam next week and I'm so nervous! Have you got any advice? How do you relax before exams? Do you think I should study all night?

model:
Hi Jade,

Don't worry, it's completely normal to feel nervous before a big exam! If I were you, I'd make a simple plan and revise a little every day.

Before exams, I usually go for a walk in the forest or listen to some calm music. It really helps me relax.

Please don't study all night! You won't remember much if you're tired. It's much better to go to bed early and have a good breakfast in the morning.

Good luck! I'm sure you'll do brilliantly.
Love,
Sam

p: It was great to hear from you.

title: The Owl's Secret Message
task: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story. Your story must begin with this sentence: “When Leo heard a tap on his window at midnight, he couldn't believe his eyes.” Write about 100 words.
firstLine: When Leo heard a tap on his window at midnight, he couldn't believe his eyes.

points.label: How Leo felt at the end

model:
When Leo heard a tap on his window at midnight, he couldn't believe his eyes. A snowy owl was sitting there with a tiny letter in its beak.

The message said: "The moon has fallen into the lake. Please help!" Without thinking, Leo put on his coat and followed the owl through the dark forest.

At the lake, the moon was floating like a giant pearl. Leo pushed it gently with a long branch until it rose back into the sky.

When he got home, he felt tired but incredibly proud, and he smiled all the way to bed.

p: It was great to hear from you.
